Situation Report — Day 27

  • Strikes and launches today: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian facilities reported. Iran and allied groups launched missiles/drones toward Israel. Northern border exchanges with Hezbollah continue daily.

Attacks & military movements

  • US/Israeli strikes on Iranian military/energy targets continue despite earlier pause violations. (Previous strikes hit Isfahan, Khorramshahr.)
  • Iranian, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/drone counterstrikes at Israel continue; air defenses active.
  • Allied logistics: repeated C‑130 movements observed; some Syrian airports closed temporarily.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah firing daily across the Lebanese border. Ground-tension remains high. Syria refuses US request to act against Hezbollah.

Hormuz & Shipping

  • Iran allows Strait of Hormuz passage for Russia, India, China while restricting others. Naval transit remains politicized — commercial risk unchanged.

Diplomacy & sanctions

  • Trump announced a 10-day second pause on Iran energy strikes (ends Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET). He cited an Iranian request; Tehran denies direct talks.
  • Pakistan is mediating communications between Washington and Tehran.
  • US Congress (Senate and House) voted to pause war powers — a symbolic rebuke to the White House.
  • UK/France/Germany reportedly ready to lift certain Iran sanctions if deal holds (Bloomberg).
  • IAEA inspectors will visit Iranian nuclear sites under the interim arrangement — parties dispute inspection/frozen-asset details.

Gaza & Homefront

  • Israeli strike in Gaza killed a teenage girl on her way to school. Medical and chronic-care shortages persist.
  • New national security adviser convened urgent meeting on civilian movement from Gaza.

International

  • Attack on Sevastopol energy infrastructure caused outages — indicates wider regional spillover risk.

🟢 Good News

  • IAEA inspectors scheduled to visit Iran. A temporary 10‑day pause on energy strikes gives a limited diplomatic window. Pakistan mediating.

Threat assessment: escalating
